text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was wondering why Machikane 
Tannhauser hadn't arrived yet—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! I ended up being late!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Actually, on my way here, I ran headfirst 
into a wall and got a nosebleed...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And my tracksuit got dirty too, so I 
thought I'd do laundry right away, but we 
were out of detergent.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, on my way to look for 
detergent, I ended up bumping into a 
door...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Things that made me want to scream 'Why 
now of all times!?' kept happening one 
after another... I'm so, so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that Matikanetannhauser was truly 
reflective, I told her to be more careful 
next time and let the matter rest.
